verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant find deals, update records, and get insights, backed by a REST API with an OpenAPI spec and deal, person, and organization endpoints. That covers the open-deals part of an agent-built account brief. Nothing in the pack shows an agent pulling recent emails or activity history through the API or MCP server. Missing for 10: documented email and mail-thread retrieval via API/MCP, activity and history endpoints or MCP tools, and hands-on evidence of an agent compiling a pre-meeting brief.
